rules: Explicit mapping wins; then prefix rules; an identical path matches itself; new-only paths get created; old-only paths are ORPHANS - kept and reported, never deleted. Always dry-run first. Case-only renames MUST use a two-step rename (X -> X__mig -> x) on case-insensitive filesystems (macOS, SMB, Dropbox).

case_only_renames.warning: These differ from their target only by case and WILL collide on a case-insensitive volume. Two-step them.

orphans_expected.library/assets/cam: 2026.01 asset types are char/prop/set/vehicle/fx/look - there is no 'cam' type. Re-home by hand (usually assets/prop or a shot's data/cam) or keep as an orphan.
orphans_expected.note: Anything not listed above and not identical is reported as an orphan and left in place. Deleting is never part of a migration.

notes.job_roots: A migration never moves a project between job roots. If a tree also changes job root, that is a separate, explicit move; the passport's job_root field is updated to the new named root and no absolute path is ever written.
notes.env_to_set: library/assets/env -> assets/set is the studio-wide 'set wins over env' decision. 'env' is retired as an asset type; 'style' likewise aliases to 'look'.
notes.dailies: work/_DAILIES becomes media/dailies: in 2026.01 dailies are an immutable review record and live under media/, not under work/.
notes.online_kit: The 2015 production/online kit becomes the conform kit at work/online/prep/{artwork,audio,edl_xml,fonts,legals,offline,slates}.
notes.flame: The 2015 flame/ node-type trees land whole under work/online/flame/ - Flame IS the online in commercial post and manages its own internal structure from there.
notes.luts: 2026.01 deliberately has TWO lut homes: lib/ocio/luts (show/technical, pipeline-managed) and work/color/luts (the colorist's own). 2015's single library/data/lut maps to the show home; move working luts by hand.
notes.shots: shots/{seq} paths are identical between the two layouts. Run shot.xml per existing shot to add the 2026.01 shot interior (52 actions), then move legacy per-shot content in.
notes.tools: library/tools -> lib/dcc carries CONFIG only. Tool source code belongs in a repo, never inside a project; a 606MB app once grew inside a real project.
notes.incoming_outgoing: Client/vendor subdirectories are retired. Dated drop folders (YYYYMMDD[-HHMM][-INITIALS]-Title) sit directly under media/io/in and media/io/out and carry the counterparty in the folder name.
notes.lazy_targets: 10 of the 52 targets do not exist in a bare scaffold and are created on first use: media/elements/{roto,textures,transcode}, work/legacy_media_work, work/production/creative, work/production/notes/shot_sheets, work/shoot/data/{cache,chan,lens,timewarp}. This is intended - the directory catalog is a guidebook, not a rulebook. A migration tool must mkdir -p its targets rather than assume the scaffold pre-made them.
